content.title: 2026 Masters: How to watch the final round of the golf tournament, where to stream, TV schedule, tee times and more
content.text: The first major of the year is in the books, and now it’s time for … a signature event?! Well, alright. Let’s watch the world’s best once more as they trek from Augusta to Hilton Head Island to tee it up at the RBC Heritage.Defending champ Justin Thomas will return after a down-to-the-wire playoff win last year. And he’ll be joined by eight of the top 10-ranked golfers in the world, including Scottie Scheffler, Cameron Young, Tommy Fleetwood, Russell Henley, Matt Fitzpatrick, Collin Morikawa, Xander Schauffele and J.J. Spaun. The only two missing are Rory McIlroy and Justin Rose. Understandable.AdvertisementTony Finau will return after missing his first major since 2018, as will recent tour winner Jacob Bridgeman, the fledgling Marco Penge and the sort of Masters contender Max Homa.Thomas won last year’s RBC Heritage on a long birdie putt on the first playoff hole to take down Andrew Novak. It was Thomas’s first win since 2022, and he was buoyed in Hilton Head by fill-in caddie Joe Greiner. It took a final-round 68 to make it to an extra hole, and JT did just enough to earn his 16th PGA Tour victory,This week's winner will receive a $3.6 million cut of the $20 million purse and 700 FedEx
